# 黃帝陰符經集註--李筌

**ID:** KR5a0109
**Custom ID:** ZB5a0109

## Authors / Editors
- 李筌 fl. 713 - 741

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A fourteen-folio Táng collected-commentaries edition (*jízhù* 集註) of the *[Huángdì yīnfú jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0031)* 黃帝陰符經. The collection contains explanations attributed to a pseudepigraphic series of ancient authorities — Yī Yǐn 伊尹, Tàigōng 太公, Fàn Lǐ 范蠡, Guǐgǔzǐ 鬼谷子, Zhūgě Liàng 諸葛亮, Zhāng Liáng 張良 — and concluding with those of the Táng compiler Lǐ Quán 李筌 himself. The preface, attributed to Zhūgě Liàng, connects the text with the Yellow Emperor but does not give the traditional information about the Old Woman of Líshān 驪山 that figures prominently in *[DZ 110 Huángdì yīnfú jīng shū](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0110)* (which is falsely ascribed to Lǐ Quán).

The "long version" (approximately 400 words; see [DZ 31](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0031)) of the *Yīnfú jīng* is not here divided into the customary three paragraphs (cf. [DZ 110](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0110)). The distribution of commentaries through the text is uneven: the commentaries attributed to Lǐ Quán are comparatively substantial but do not match the commentaries attributed to him in DZ 110. Lǐ Quán's commentaries prompted Zhāng Guǒ 張果 to write his own (*[DZ 112 Huángdì yīnfú jīng zhù](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0112)*) in order to refute Lǐ Quán's opinions — which confirms Lǐ Quán's authorship of the commentaries attributed to him in the present collection. The compilation itself can be attributed to Lǐ Quán, whose name occupies the last and chronologically most recent position at the end of the long series of authors. Lǐ Quán offers naturalistic interpretations that seem to be based on historical events or on data referring to military and political actions.

**Abstract**

Florian C. Reiter, in Schipper & Verellen eds., *The Taoist Canon* (2004) 1:322 (§2.A.1), identifies Lǐ Quán 李筌 (*fl.* 713–741) as the compiler of the collection and as the author of the substantive commentaries attributed to his own name. The frontmatter brackets composition notBefore 713 / notAfter 741 (Lǐ Quán's *floruit*), with dynasty 唐. Lǐ Quán is the sole catalog-meta person wikilinked.
